CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

2. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

4. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

5. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.

8. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.

9. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

11. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   D. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

1. B — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. B — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — The speed of the music

6. B — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Red, blue, and yellow

11. D — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
